accuracy = max(accuracies, default=60)
    intervals = calendar + repeat
    if not intervals:
        return None, None
    overall = max(intervals) + accuracy
evidence.reason: `_timer_schedule_seconds` computes the completion bound from `OnCalendar`, `OnUnitActiveSec`, `OnUnitInactiveSec`, and `AccuracySec` only. It never reads `RandomizedDelaySec`, which systemd applies as an additional delay before activating the timer. A timer template declaring that directive can therefore activate later than the returned bound while still passing the template validator, so preflight can admit a deadline that systemd will exceed. This is an ordinary correctness gap in the existing bound computation, not a new requirement; account for the directive in the bound or reject timers that declare it.
